commit c5ccbca5a3bc5eb213e2281d85515859a7134b4f
Author:     Richard Marti <richard.marti@gmail.com>
AuthorDate: Thu Apr 24 16:23:55 2025 +0000
Commit:     Richard Marti <richard.marti@gmail.com>
CommitDate: Thu Apr 24 16:23:55 2025 +0000

    Bug 1962393 - Port bug 1960981: Back out Bug 1907124 (Bypassing Updates for Multiple Profiles feature). r=mkmelin
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D246593

diff --git a/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js b/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
index a9375718e2a..e5d5484ad9f 100644
--- a/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
+++ b/mail/app/profile/all-thunderbird.js
@@ -161,19 +161,6 @@ pref("app.releaseNotesURL", "https://live.thunderbird.net/%APP%/releasenotes?loc
   pref("app.update.noWindowAutoRestart.delayMs", 300000);
 #endif
 
-// The Multi Session Install Lockout prevents updates from being installed at
-// startup when they normally would be if there are other instances using the
-// installation. We only do this for a limited amount of time before we go ahead
-// and apply the update anyways.
-// Hopefully, at some point, updating Thunderbird while it is running will not break
-// things and this mechanism can be removed.
-// Note that these prefs are bit dangerous because having different values in
-// different profiles could cause erratic behavior.
-// This feature is also affected by
-// `app.update.multiSessionInstallLockout.timeoutMs`, which is in the branding
-// section.
-pref("app.update.multiSessionInstallLockout.enabled", true);
-
 // URL for "Learn More" for DataCollection
 pref("toolkit.datacollection.infoURL",
      "https://www.mozilla.org/thunderbird/legal/privacy/#telemetry");
diff --git a/mail/branding/include/release-prefs.js b/mail/branding/include/release-prefs.js
index 058131f3e8f..ece625d7022 100644
--- a/mail/branding/include/release-prefs.js
+++ b/mail/branding/include/release-prefs.js
@@ -20,14 +20,6 @@ pref("app.update.checkInstallTime.days", 63);
 // Give the user x seconds to reboot before showing a badge on the hamburger
 // button. default=4 days
 pref("app.update.badgeWaitTime", 345600);
-// This represents the duration between an update being ready and it being
-// possible to install it while other sessions are running. Note that
-// having this pref's duration differ from `app.update.badgeWaitTime` may result
-// in undefined behavior such as showing an update prompt that does not result
-// in an update when the "Restart to Update" button is clicked. Keep in mind
-// that this is in milliseconds and `app.update.badgeWaitTime` is in seconds.
-// Note that the effective value of this pref is limited to 1 week, maximum.
-pref("app.update.multiSessionInstallLockout.timeoutMs", 345600000);
 
 pref("app.vendorURL", "https://www.thunderbird.net/%LOCALE%/");
 
diff --git a/mail/branding/nightly/pref/thunderbird-branding.js b/mail/branding/nightly/pref/thunderbird-branding.js
index 87b8c4dde9c..56e8dff26b2 100644
--- a/mail/branding/nightly/pref/thunderbird-branding.js
+++ b/mail/branding/nightly/pref/thunderbird-branding.js
@@ -36,14 +36,6 @@ pref("app.update.checkInstallTime.days", 2);
 // Give the user x seconds to reboot before showing a badge on the hamburger
 // button. default=immediately
 pref("app.update.badgeWaitTime", 0);
-// This represents the duration between an update being ready and it being
-// possible to install it while other sessions are running. Note that
-// having this pref's duration differ from `app.update.badgeWaitTime` may result
-// in undefined behavior such as showing an update prompt that does not result
-// in an update when the "Restart to Update" button is clicked. Keep in mind
-// that this is in milliseconds and `app.update.badgeWaitTime` is in seconds.
-// Note that the effective value of this pref is limited to 1 week, maximum.
-pref("app.update.multiSessionInstallLockout.timeoutMs", 0);
 
 pref("app.vendorURL", "https://www.thunderbird.net/%LOCALE%/");
